title: Accessibility studio
idea: Accessibility studio: Text input motion and audio options each have a live preview
audience: People who need to configure accessibility within a game surface.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic workspace layout through its configure accessibility priority and explicit commitment contract: Preview and saved settings states remain distinct
navigation: Accessibility studio keeps the current configure accessibility context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Text input motion and audio options each have a live preview
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to configure accessibility; players need tailored interaction
composition.priority: Preview and saved settings states remain distinct

imagery.role: Support the actual configure accessibility context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Use scalable labels and predictable focus groups
Compose for safe zones, aspect ratio and the actual input device; preserve world readability.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the accessibility studio structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no configure accessibility content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Preview and saved settings states remain distinct
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized configure accessibility content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Preview and saved settings states remain distinct
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active configure accessibility context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure frame-time and input latency in the real engine; DOM checks cannot certify in-world UI.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
